Mechanism: funder-cut-sybil-tax
How: every payout names its funding vertex, and a second key on that vertex keeps 40% while 60% burns. Cost: each extra identity forfeits 0.6 of the epoch reward, so ten copies surrender six full payouts. Check: peers recompute parent links; accounts spread across a meadow still fail when one trellis of shared funding breaks the 40% cap.
